# Limitations and future work

This chapter is the engineering honesty section. The lab taught me a lot; it is also incomplete in ways that matter if someone wants to extend it.

## Limitations

### No FID or Inception Score

I judged generative samples by eye on PNG grids. That is enough for a learning walkthrough. It is not enough to claim ranked generative quality. Any statement on this site about VAE blur, DCGAN sharpness, or diffusion sample readability is qualitative.

### MNIST only, 28×28 grayscale

Digits are a teaching dataset. Results here do not transfer automatically to natural images, color, or higher resolution. I used MNIST because mistakes are visible and iteration is fast, not because it represents real-world vision.

### Duplicate VAE training

Both `vae.ipynb` and `latent_diffusion_mlp.ipynb` train a VAE. That was convenient while I was learning the pipeline. It is poor artifact hygiene for a real project. The latent-diffusion notebook should load a checkpoint instead of retraining.

### Comparison notebook hygiene

`02_mnist_models.ipynb` may contain duplicate CNN rows from re-runs. I cite **0.9913** as the comparison CNN accuracy. The exported comparison table preserves more than one CNN entry.

### Gitignored training artifacts

Checkpoints and large arrays live outside git on purpose:

| Path | Contents |
|------|----------|
| `training_results/` | VAE weights, local plots, pickles |
| `latent_data/` | Extracted latent arrays |
| `*.pth` / `ddpm_mnist*.pth` | Model checkpoints |

Metrics and figures in `results/` are the portable record. Full retraining is optional.

## Future work

- Deduplicate the VAE pipeline: train once, load `vae_model.pth` in the latent-diffusion notebook.
- Add FID or classifier-based generative scores so sample quality claims can be quantitative.
- Guard or remove Colab-only cells for cleaner local runs.
- Extend the same notebook structure to Fashion-MNIST.
- Optional `nbconvert` CI smoke test to catch broken imports without full training.

::: {.callout-warning}
## What I am not claiming

I am not claiming a new MNIST record, a production vision system, or a generative model ranked by FID/IS. I am claiming a reproducible learning path with saved outputs, honest metrics, and documented rough edges.
:::
